games.name: Kurousa Just Wants to Go Home
Mystery of the Mysterious Futayuri Mystery Dungeon
The Hero is too Powerful so let's Pleeeease Settle this Peacefully!
Alph Last Bastion
games.summary: The bug swarm is coming, and your bastion is the last thing standing in its way. Build a fortress of turrets anywhere on the battlefield, power it up, and hold the line against relentless hordes and monstrous bosses. Fall, upgrade your arsenal, and return stronger.

games.name: Beat That Meat
games.summary: Beat Your Meat is a ridiculous clicker game where you smack your way through 8 types of meat, unlock 8 absurd weapons, and endure relentless sarcastic commentary from a thoroughly unimpressed British woman. You keep beating. She'll keep judging.

games.name: Bee Shrimp Aquarium
games.summary: A 3D aquarium game for watching bee shrimp. Zoom in to see them graze, groom and swim, or feed them and watch them gather. Choose from 12+ aquascapes, change the lighting, and customize the shrimp's patterns, colors and sizes.

games.name: Behelade
games.summary: Wield the “Behelade” to fight your way through this challenging Bullet Hell Shoot ‘Em Up and find out what is behind the mysterious power that made the animals go on a mad Danmaku rampage!

games.name: Big Fox Family Time
games.summary: A cozy first-person family sim where your fox family doubles every night. Hunt, chop, build a den and tuck your kits into bed, then command a crowd of thousands at once, from three kits up to 65,536. Play solo or in online co-op with up to four parents.

games.name: Blamcon's Light Gun Madness
games.summary: Light Gun Madness is a travelling shooting show for your PC Light Guns. Test your skills, play with friends. A great party game. Use one light gun and pass it around to see who gets the best scores or play head to head with 2~4 light guns at the same time. You can use a mouse but it's not the same.

games.name: BlastBeacon
games.summary: Minesweeper, in first person. Step onto the board deep in dark, ancient ruins, read the glowing numbers, and dig with your pickaxe. Just don't hit the wrong block.

games.name: Breakdance Simulator
games.summary: Breakdance Simulator is a wild party game that brings breakdancing to your living room. Every move is danced with real physics, so a perfect headspin and a spectacular faceplant are never far apart. Think you can build the ultimate routine?

games.name: Cats to Mars
games.summary: A strategic 2D physics game where you stack adorable cats to reach Mars. Use each cat's unique size and weight to build your tower as high as possible!

games.name: Celebria
games.summary: Build a career in music, acting or both in this celebrity simulation, where your story unfolds through text and choices. Release singles and albums, audition for screen roles, climb global charts, headline tours, chase awards and launch businesses while navigating the pressures of fame.

games.name: Chess Variant: Chase The King Demo
Clash of Crests - The Purple and the Fire
Crazy Chess
games.summary: A game based on chess. Solve 50 puzzles on boards of every kind and shape, with different types of tiles. Mechanics and rules that are a little crazy but a lot of fun.

games.name: Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 1
Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 2
Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 3
Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 4
Crazy Chess – Developer Support Pack - Lvl 5
Dejinochi
games.summary: Raise a tiny virtual pet that lives on your desktop. Feed it, care for it, watch it grow into different creatures, and eventually say goodbye as it heads out into the world — though old friends might still come back to visit.

games.name: Desert Cleaner
games.summary: Tidy up the oasis! Scoop the desert into your backpack, turn sand into gold and upgrade from a cotton glove to a full-blown sandstorm. Uncover a green oasis, hidden treasure and helpful robots, alone or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

games.name: Digbound
games.summary: Dig. Sell. Upgrade. Dig deeper.

games.name: Don't Look Back.
games.summary: 『ふりむいちゃだめ』は、廃校となった学校を探索し、怪異から逃げながら脱出を目指すシングルプレイヤー向け3Dホラーゲームです。探索中には「動くな」「高い場所へ逃げろ」「指定された色の場所へ向かえ」「隠れろ」など、さまざまな命令が突然発生します。暗い校舎を探索して鍵やアイテムを集め、安全な場所を見つけながら命令を乗り越えてください。怪異に見つかったときは、教室や廊下、階段を利用して追跡を振り切り、学校からの脱出を目指します。

games.name: DUMMY HOUSE
games.summary: First-person psychological horror and survival. Use your camera and sound to identify and repel enemies that mimic humans in total darkness, uncover disturbing secrets, and face increasingly intense nights in an industrial complex with multiple endings and high replayability.

games.name: Etranger In the City of Doom
games.summary: In a fantasy world floating in the sky, the amnesiac girl Tio sets out to rescue the imprisoned angel Norn. Along the way, she deepens her bond with Rikill, befriends the townspeople, and faces the fate of a dying town. An emotional adventure about growth, friendship, and hope.

games.name: Evil Maiden: The Noble Warrior and the Demon Armor
Fast Point
games.summary: Fast Point is a pickup point business simulator where you start with a small location, a few shelves, and your first customers. Receive deliveries, organize packages in storage, hand out orders, process returns, and make sure the queue doesn't turn into chaos.

games.name: Football Manager: Auto Chess - Idle Desktop Pet Expansion
GIFT from GOD
games.summary: GIFT from GOD is a visual novel told through the eyes of Ryosuke Nikaido and Akane Yamamoto. As they face three missions from God, their hearts, pasts, and choices begin to intertwine, leading them toward the true meaning of God’s “gift.”

games.name: Haunted Echoes
games.summary: Haunted Echoes is a raw psychological horror game experienced through a bodycam perspective. Explore abandoned, eerie locations, manage your limited flashlight, face terrifying anomalies hidden in the dark, and try to survive a nightmare where every single move is being recorded.

games.name: Hero Tower Defense
games.summary: Hero Tower Defense is a top-down roguelike tower defense game. Recruit 70+ unique heroes, use platforms and fences to redirect enemy routes, and combine skills, plugins, equipment, gems, and team bonds. Adapt to randomized recruits, rewards, and enemy compositions across 120 waves.

games.name: Hidden Front
games.summary: Hidden Front is a military real-time strategy game for up to 6 players. Deploy your army, scout through the fog of war and combine infantry, armor, artillery and air support. Fight other commanders or team up with friends against bots.

games.name: Idol On Duty
games.summary: A Beat-Em-Up starring a J-Pop-inspired magical girl Aiko who bashes corporate demons over the head while swapping between a Pop mode and a Metal mode.

games.name: Interplanetary Farmer
games.summary: Demand runs ahead of supply, growers are being recruited. You are one of them: you pick a planet, take over a plot of land, and run it remotely through a tracked robot called the Farmoton. You make money (nibs) by growing crops and selling them to the traders who dock at your farm's market each day.

games.name: Iron Reactor
games.summary: A Soviet reactor has gone silent. Enter ZHELEZO in this dark retro FPS, battle radioactive mutants and uncover a reality beyond the walls. Fight through 24 levels across four acts, wield seven weapons and face endless enemy waves in Survival mode.

games.name: Jerry and Jaspers Jovial Journey
games.summary: A simple 2-4 hour RPG experience involving traditional turn based combat, mission variations based on player choices, and various unique puzzles.

games.name: Kintsugi Cottage
games.summary: A cozy 3D jigsaw restoration game. Hundreds of shards lie across a cottage museum floor, and every glaze, curve and pattern is a clue. Work out which pieces belong together, rebuild the artifacts by hand, and restore the full artifact collection.

games.name: Last Bake
games.summary: You play as a young woman taking a temporary evening job at a bakery on New Year's Eve. Your task is to serve a variety of customers while trying to uncover why, instead of holiday cheer, this place is shrouded in darkness...

games.name: Maximum Aura
games.summary: Farm aura. Bonk googly-eyed NPCs to a phonk beat. Do not get cooked. A frantic top-down arcade survival shooter: auto-fire, dash through crowds, stack ridiculous upgrades, and unleash BRAINROT MODE when your aura bar is full.

games.name: Medieval Adventure
games.summary: Build a medieval settlement into a thriving regional power. Manage villagers, production, seasons and trade; explore a living world, establish resource outposts, forge alliances, and defend your people from bandits and hardship.

games.name: MEIFU KANSHIKI-KA: The Underworld Forensics Division
games.summary: You died at 4:44 a.m. Now you're the Underworld's forensic examiner. Rebuild the shattered memories of the dead with Picross, battle lying spirits, expose false testimony before King Enma — and find out who erased your own page.

games.name: Menio
games.summary: Care unit Pell can see that Runch needs help. MENIO says he isn't eligible. When its supervisor needs that same care, refusal starts to look like revenge. A short psychological horror visual novel about empathy, accountability, and institutional cruelty.

games.name: Musunoa: The Faceless
games.summary:
Lanterns light the streets of Seirin for a night of celebration. Then the first houses catch fire. Soldiers emerge from the darkness, strike and vanish.

Ren refuses to let them escape. Pursuing the attackers, he discovers an entire army beyond the river. His village is still tending its wounded. If he loses the crossing, the attackers will reach its gates before the villagers can escape.

Alongside Aya, Ren enters a war that leads him back to the secrets of his own family. Behind enemy masks and the silence of those closest to him, he searches for the same answer: who can he still trust?

Take command in a turn-based strategy adventure. Hold the crossings, advance through the fog and prepare your attacks: the soldiers you lead are the last line of defense between your village and the approaching army.

games.name: My Bookstore
games.summary: Start with empty shelves and a dream in My Bookstore! Buy books, manage your inventory, serve customers, and grow your little shop into a thriving bookstore. Stock your shelves, ring up sales, and build the bookstore every book lover dreams of!

games.name: My Dream Sport Dating Simulator - Supporter Pack
My Galaxy Buddy
games.summary: A relaxing idler that sits on your desktop. Interact with it on your own terms while you work on other tasks! Extract items from 8 unique biomes! Purchase upgrades to discover rare planets!Customize your UFO and extract items in style!Discover all biomes and collect every item to fill out your archive!

games.name: New Age War: Online
games.summary: A first-person shooter where every bullet is a real projectile with its own speed and drop. Build your weapon from 34 guns, then fight online in lobbies of up to 16 players or against bots across a Mexican valley town, the Ukrainian steppe and an open sea of jets.

games.name: No Visitors Allowed
games.summary: A minimalist psychological horror game inspired by The Exit 8, where players must escape a looping post-Soviet-era abandoned hospital corridor by detecting anomalies.

games.name: Peaceward Chronicles
games.summary: A turn-based card strategy game set in the Taiping Rebellion. Guided by Heaven, you become Hong Xiuquan, God's second son. Unlock characters, build a team, and exploit Five Elements matchups and formation bonuses. Complete six story chapters; unlock roguelike challenges after Chapter 2.

games.name: Pop Corner
games.summary: A relaxing match-3 that floats in a corner of your screen with a transparent background. Match coffee mugs, folders and sticky notes while you work, without leaving what you're doing.

games.name: Porchlight
games.summary: Summer, 1997. Thirteen-year-old Wes Harlan shines his grandpa's old flashlight into the porch light and opens a door to Callowmere, a storybook kingdom laid out just like his Ohio town. Cross between the two worlds, relight their lamps, and bring the color back to both.

games.name: Prayer Chest
games.summary: A group of young adventurers set out to dispel the darkness lurking within people’s hearts. A nostalgic 3D fantasy RPG inspired by the atmosphere of early‑2000s games.

games.name: Prison Legacy
games.summary: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

games.name: Project Overboard
games.summary: Design a cruise ship deck by deck, hire the crew and take paying guests out to sea. Keep them fed, entertained and away from reception while the buffet runs low, the lifts back up and somebody does something in the pool.

games.name: Rally Panic with the BRO!
games.summary: One drives. One navigates. Both panic! Team up with up to 8 players in 4 cars for chaotic co-op rallying. Dodge wildlife, wipe mud off the windshield, and trust your navigator’s directions. Paint your car, buckle up, and try to keep the friendship on the road.

games.name: Randal's Weekend
games.summary: A lighthearted RPG where Randal and Matt embark on a tabletop role-playing adventure, with Charlie as their Dungeon Master. Eager to finish the game as quickly as possible, they’ll have to deal with Charlie’s twisted challenges, facing combat, exploring dangerous dungeons and solving puzzles.

games.name: Random Slot Adventurers : Matched Words... Now I'm the Strongest
games.summary: Build a 3x3 slot board in this word-combination strategy roguelike. Combine Subjects, Adverbs, and Verbs to attack, defend, and heal. Explore changing islands, collect words and relics, and shape a build around class traits and synergies.

games.name: Resettle
games.summary: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

games.name: Resort Architect
games.summary: Operate your own resort! Manage the hotel front desk, build guest rooms, prepare meals, run the bar, and design and construct everything yourself. Accumulate profits, continue to expand, and make your resort grow stronger day by day, becoming a popular choice!

games.name: Stable Champs
games.summary: Build your stable. Chase the Golden Silks. Buy, breed and train racehorses, develop your yard and plan your Flat or Jumps campaign in this single-player management sim. Watch races unfold in 3D, become Champion Trainer and return to defend your title.

games.name: Streaming Tycoon
games.summary: Run a streaming company under a board that can fire you. Negotiate with stars, produce films, series and shows, and refresh your catalogue as audiences lose interest. Build a talent agency and choose which contracts, productions and risks are worth taking.

games.name: Summonforge: Idle RPG
games.summary: Compete with other players for the top spot on the leaderboards! Summon 80 unique heroes, build powerful teams, and conquer endless worlds in this fantasy idle RPG. Fuse champions, evolve skills, collect legendary equipment, and keep progressing even while offline!

games.name: Sunny Side Up - Puzzle TBS
games.summary: Sunny Side Up offers a mix between TBS and Puzzle gameplay. Your goal is to bloom all the flowers on the board by playing your cards strategically from your hand. Try to score as many points as you can, but make sure to bloom all the flowers before the deck runs out! With 24 levels for hours of fun.

games.name: The Heir's Guild
games.summary: A turn-based RPG Roguelite where your choices will pave the path to victory! The Dragon Queen Tiametia threatens to take control of Realm... It is up to you, the Heir, to rally three loyal subjects to battle your way back to the Grand Palace and put an end to her tyranny!

games.name: The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM!
games.summary: Be a witch, build a tower, and BOOOOM the attacking monsters in this short incremental RPG!

games.name: The Seven Beacons
games.summary: An idle RPG that lives in a thin strip above your Windows taskbar. While you work, your party fights on its own through 22 zones toward the Demon King. On a short break, open the panel: gear, talents, farm, alchemy, forge, and seven beacons to defend.

games.name: The Turret and the Hare
games.summary: A cute, chunky auto-shooter tower defense. Your rider's cannon fires on its own: pick the upgrades, grow the tower from wood to steel, send guns on carts to hunt, and blast critter hordes through day, night and storms. 18 riders, VS and co-op with friends.

games.name: Tidesong
games.summary: Trade your office job for a brass diving helmet and a little farm on the sea floor. Grow kelp and sea grapes, raise urchins and tuna, befriend the merfolk of Coral Cove and wake a bleached old reef back to life in this cozy underwater farming game.

games.name: Tidy Up the Flower Shop: Christmas
games.summary: Return to the flower shop for a Christmas tidy-up. Sort 16 festive flower varieties, stock gifts, decorate the tree, and discover the notes left behind.

games.name: TURBOCARDS
games.summary: Klondike, Spider and FreeCell for your computer and your handheld. Play with mouse, keyboard or controller — however you like, on whatever you like. Four skin sets, modifiers and a Daily Challenge with verified deals. Windows, macOS, Linux and SteamOS.

games.name: Vela
games.summary: Vela is a relaxing solitaire card game. Group cards to create tricks based of their landscapes, seasons and elements. Weather phenomena will multiply your trick scores in surprising ways! Every game is random, offering virtually infinite replayability.

games.name: Volleyball Coach Simulator 2027
games.summary: Take charge of a men’s or women’s volleyball club. Recruit players, plan every training session, set your tactics and coach each point live. Rise from your domestic league to the European cups, lead a national team and build your legacy, alone or with up to 10 coaches.

games.name: Wand Keeper
games.summary: Have you ever wanted to star in your own movie? Well now you can! ACT IT OUT is a new interactive game that lets you create, share and have fun with family and friends. Prove that you have what it takes to be part of Hollywood!Act It out makes you the director and the star in your own mini movie, but don’t give away the name of it. Then send the challenge to friends and family to guess what your movie was, if they can guess it right, you both win! Act It Out is the most addictive social game, and it is now available for free!Good luck and we can't wait to see you on the red carpet!PRAISE FOR ACT IT OUT!"? ? ? ? ? games.name: WE'RE ALL IN!
games.summary: ROLL ROLL ROLL! An online 1-4 player co-op physics-based “rube-goldberg-like” gambling game! Place ramps, cannons, turrets, and other contraptions in the name of maximum Dopamine. Unlock zany items to harass your friends, avoid dangerous side effects of gambling, and survive the clinic trial…

games.name: Wyrmhold
games.summary: Battle to the halls of the dragon's fortress with unique heroes. Four unique decks with distinct play styles. Block, bleed, burn and parry your way to the final boss. Die, draft, climb again.

games.name: You Can Sort It!
games.summary: A cozy soda-sorting sim set in a little shop. All 5760 cans have spilled across the floor - pick them up, read the labels, and shelve every one by flavor. No timers, no pressure. Sort alone, or with up to three friends.

games.name: Dad's Gonna Be a Travel Influencer.
Dad’s Gonna Be a Travel Influencer.
ゾンビポリス ～ゾンビ刑事と凍てつく真夏のお正月～ Soundtrack
Beyond the Masque of the Red Death
games.summary: Explore a gothic, macabre environment and find objects of symbolic significance, in this text-based adventure game inspired by "The Masque of the Red Death" by Edgar Allan Poe. Interact by typing your intentions in text, in an authentically written story that goes Beyond where the original one ends.

games.name: Cat Survivor
games.summary: Cat Survivor is a minefield auto-battler where mines become your greatest weapon. Read the numbers, place your flags, trigger explosive chain reactions, and wipe out entire hordes. Win with strategy, not brute force.

games.name: DeepBreaker
games.summary: Break through solid rock with your bare hands. Smash blocks, upgrade your power at the Workbench, unlock stronger gloves, fight enemies, and uncover what lies beyond the walls.

games.name: Gorse Roll
games.summary: Steer a ray-traced glass marble along floating roads of ice, mirrors and spinning floors. Race the clock through five worlds, hunt hidden sun crystals to earn a sixth, then build your own courses in an editor that traces every change as you make it.

games.name: Heya! Sumo Manager
games.summary: Heya! Sumo Manager allows you to manage a sumo stable and develop the skills of your rikishi on their road to Yokozuna! Climb from Jonokuchi to Sekitori by organizing the diet, training and tactics of your wrestlers and see them compete in 3D matches.

games.name: IcerKid
games.summary: Welcome to IcerKid! Dive into a chilly, fast-paced puzzle-action adventure where your goal is to survive and conquer dynamic levels. Strategy, control, and thinking skills are required to advance to higher levels and compete on global leaderboards.

games.name: KAREI - ENDLESS DEATH MATCH
games.summary: A grid-based, turn-based puzzle roguelike. Play a lone kunoichi ascending an endless castle — read each floor like a puzzle, arm yourself from its walls, and cut down the oni in your path. One wrong move ends your run.

games.name: Keep The Ammo Flowing
games.summary: A top-down incremental logistics and tower-defense game. Mine resources, produce ammunition, build tracks toward the exit, and upgrade your mobile furnace and turret while defending it from underground swarms.

games.name: Little Lua & The Lost Six
games.summary: Six kids are torn from their world and dropped into Everbloom, a realm poisoned by the Blight. Build your squad, master fire, ice, and lightning magic, and fight your way through shifting seasons to free everyone the Blight has taken — including your own parents.

games.name: Party Home: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Clean up after the party in this cozy first-person co-op game! Put every item back where it belongs, scrub away the stains, toss the trash and play satisfying mini-games – solo or with a friend, online or split-screen – before Mom gets home.

games.name: Ravenhill: Initiation
games.summary: After a bitter argument with Hannah, Ethan vanishes while auditing files in quarantined Ravenhill Valley. When police refuse to enter the restricted zone, Hannah ventures into the fog-drenched woods to find her boyfriend. What she uncovers is an ancient threat and an ever-shifting nightmare reality.

games.name: Token Club: AI Desktop Pet
games.summary: A desktop pet for people who code with AI. When you prompt your agent (Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity), your mascot runs to the stage and dances while customers throw bills worth what that prompt costs at API prices.

games.name: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
A Drop of Magenta
games.summary: A Drop of Magenta is a puzzle game about painting inside (and outside) the lines.

games.name: Alienshire
games.summary: Alienshire is a classic real-time strategy game where you command an alien force, harvest a familiar landscape, produce units, and fight for control of the territory.

games.name: Ancient Moves: Hnefatafl (Viking Chess)
games.summary: Command the siege or lead a royal escape in Ancient Moves: Hnefatafl, a Viking strategy board game. Capture the king with 24 attackers or break through with 12 defenders and their king. Play solo against four AI difficulty levels or challenge a friend on the same device or online.

games.name: Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn
games.summary: A cozy first-person sorting game. Three thousand weapons lie in a heap across a two-floor medieval armoury, and every one has exactly one right place. Learn the hall, earn the skills that reveal it, and set it all right before dawn — alone or with friends.

games.name: Aspect Arena
games.summary: Inspired by The Walking Dead.Zombie Apocalypse is here and walkers are everywhere.There is nowhere to hide and the only way to survive is to kill the dead before they get to you and eat your brains.Brace yourself and survive the long night of the undead. Watch out for zombies from all directions.Don't forget to reload for a gun without ammo is just a club.WARNING! This game is not for the faint hearted.

games.name: Blendead
games.summary: Find me. I'm right in front of you. A multiplayer blend-and-seek where you pose as an NPC in a crowd — one mistake and you're dead.

games.name: Bouture
games.summary: Pot little living plants on your Windows desktop. They grow while you work, droop when they're thirsty and bloom after weeks of care. Water them, take cuttings and fill your herbarium: a calm companion that lives behind your windows, or above them.

games.name: Catch the Button
games.summary: A chaotic reaction game where every single click counts! Chase the moving button, build insane streaks, survive unpredictable events and watch out for tricks. Think you're fast enough to catch it?

games.name: Christmas Market: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: The Christmas feast is over and the harbour market is buried in mess of 3486 objects. Join up to 8 friends as the Night Crew of cozy elves, carry armfuls of plates, baubles and gingerbread back where they belong, and have the snowy market sparkling before sunrise.

games.name: Climb, Cube, Climb!
games.summary: Climb, Cube, Climb! is a cute rage-game inspired platformer where the primary obstacle standing in your way is gravity. Employ a diverse set of movement skills to ascend to the top, but be wary: falling is a guarantee.

games.name: Dungeon Troll
games.summary: A 2D platformer for two players online. Jump, dodge and survive a dungeon packed with sneaky traps while you and your friend race to see who gets further. Only one walks away the winner.

games.name: Escape the Baby Alarm
games.summary:
Escape the Baby Alarm is a cozy, escape room-inspired puzzle game that explores the chaos and love of becoming a new parent. 

Built from my own experience, the game is a love letter to parenthood. An era defined by love and connection, but also extreme sleep deprivation, questionable hygiene standards, and the superpower of functioning on 2% battery with a baby in one hand and a cold coffee in the other.

games.name: Fantasy Auction House
games.summary: Start with 10 gold and trade your way to a fortune. Browse a fantasy auction house, spot underpriced goods, set your own resale prices and collect sales by mail. Merchants from across the world keep the listings changing.

games.name: Femme Fury(Pure Classic Simple Action Game)
games.summary: A fast-paced action game with a taste for lowbrow sexuality. No puzzles. No complicated progression. Just you, your enemies, and a little bit of strategy. Use your surroundings, outsmart your enemies, and find your own way to take them down. Simple, shameless, and unapologetically trashy.

games.name: Flock Hunt
games.summary: A first-person stealth game about taking down mass surveillance cameras and fighting a dystopian future. Every camera you break brings The Flock a little closer. Sneak out at night and destroy cameras with a growing arsenal of tools, sell camera scrap for upgrades, and hire a crew.

games.name: Frame343
games.summary: At a small data recovery firm you restore the camera of a man missing since 2011, at his sister's request. File 343 is missing. Dark records appear only while you hold Develop. But the camera is looking for a face, and when it finds one, it shoots. Short horror built on real photos and timestamps.

games.name: Friendly Mining Company
games.summary: A pixelated idle clicker about taking planets apart, layer by layer. Build a combo, buy a fleet, automate the grind, and push through a galaxy that for now seems devoid of life... Or is it?

games.name: Glowmonkey2k
games.summary: Fight through a corrupted digital world as Glowmonkey, switching weapons on the fly to defeat enemies immune to the wrong attack.

games.name: GNOMINAL
games.summary: $50,000 in debt. Clock in each night and shoot garden gnomes for the cash inside, but every bullet is billed to your balance. When the horn sounds, clock out with your takings, or stay for overtime—bigger payouts, bigger losses.

games.name: Goblin Island
games.summary: Grow, water, and harvest your way to riches in this farming incremental game. Create your goblin and walk around a living garden, chase rare mutations, hire goblin companions, and build your farm business from a humble plot into a goblin empire.

games.name: Goldbar In A S***stack
games.summary: There is one gold bar hidden inside a gigantic pile of s***. No clues. Dig it out by hand, hire an army of idiots, survive flying cows, UFOs and the foot of God, and scale up from a dog's little business to a planet made of 200 million chunks.

games.name: Hoard (Radikate)
games.summary: Two goblins, six worlds, and a dragon's hoard at the end of the road. Forge keys, crack open chests, dodge (or slay) the mimics, and pour your gold into upgrades and goblin helpers. A short, funny idle adventure where every chest could be loot... or teeth.

games.name: Huex
games.summary: A hex-grid line puzzle. Drag lines across the board until every hex is covered. Play a new puzzle every day, work through the stages, or build your own and share it with friends. Simple rules, challenging puzzles.

games.name: Idle Game Dev Studio
games.summary: Run your own game studio in this idle management game. Develop and release games, automate the work, and turn your growing catalog into steady income. Give flops another chance, build sequels, then sell your studio for permanent bonuses and start again.

games.name: Internet Cafe 98
games.summary: Start with one trash PC and build a packed 1998 internet cafe. Serve customers, upgrade your hardware and network, and research new tech in this retro incremental tycoon.

games.name: Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler
games.summary: Jaden Industries is a relaxing factory-building puzzle game about managing compact crafting chains across floating islands. As an expedition engineer, you’ll explore a peaceful Archipelago, configure production flows, refine resources, and achieve perfect efficiency.

games.name: KARAKARA3
games.summary: "Let us live on this land so arid." Leon's peaceful days suddenly come to an end when he hears the sound of a telephone, a Relic from the past and is informed that Cullen, a member of the town vigilante corp, is being held hostage. The final chapter in the KARAKARA series.

games.name: Mantle (2026)
games.summary: Mantle is a multiplayer creation platform built on Unreal Engine 5. Publish playable worlds in seconds, then join instantly through one client with no per-place download. Explore worlds made by other creators, team up with friends, and build your own using the in-editor tools.

games.name: Margin Matters
games.summary: You run a manufacturing company. Customers send you offers, and every one of them ties up a production site for a number of rounds. Accept the wrong ones and your plants sit full of poor margins. Accept the right ones and you earn the capital to expand. It sounds simple. It isn’t.

games.name: Midnight Shift 2: Last Rental
games.summary: A 90's horror inspired first-person game about working the midnight shift at a video rental store.

games.name: Moose Builders
games.summary: Dig sand with a shovel and process into iron, silicon and more. Craft and merge better tools and machines to build solar panels and power your factory. Research new machines to automate everything in voxel-based multi-story factories. Play alone or with friends and turn the desert into a solar farm.

games.name: My Little Shadow
games.summary: A little daughter, right on your desktop. Choose a child to share your days with: she plays, draws you gifts, gets a little mischievous, and naps nearby while you work. Share snacks, play together, and grow closer at your own pace—without daily chores or guilt for being away.

games.name: Neon Run
games.summary: Neon Run is a fast-paced precision platformer inspired by old-school arcade games. Jump, slide and dash through challenging levels, master their patterns, discover hidden secrets, defeat enemies and bosses, and unlock new content as you progress.

games.name: NEONOVA Puzzle: Red
games.summary: NEONOVA Puzzle: Red is an atmospheric jigsaw puzzle game that combines anime aesthetics with Christmas-inspired neon cyberpunk. Assemble futuristic images, connect the pieces, and unlock vibrant illustrations filled with glowing neon, festive decorations, mysterious characters and technologies.

games.name: Nightclub Security
games.summary: In this absurd first-person bouncer game, you have 10 seconds to decide who gets into the club. Check IDs, catch drunks and hidden contraband, confiscate forbidden items, then let them in - or slap, shove, grab, and throw them out.

games.name: Nik and Kit
games.summary: Albertino - a friendly physicist has some lessons for you. No matter how good you are at school you can now take few more lessons and try this awesome puzzle game with a beautiful cartoony graphics and stunning gameplay. The goal of each level is to connect light emitters with corresponding receptors – sounds easy, eh? You might want to try it yourself!Features:•80 challenging levels (more to come!)•Stunning 2D cartoon graphics & animation•Original music by Justin Sandercoe!•Highly polished gameplay•Game Center enabled•Achievements•Online leaderboards•In-game tutorial

games.name: Orby vs Rects
games.summary: Break the Rects. Collect Recties. Upgrade. Repeat. Orby vs Rects is a retro-inspired shooter that captures the spirit of Arkanoid and Tetris classics, while delivering modern fast-paced bullet-hell action.

games.name: PC Store Together
games.summary: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.

games.name: Pheles Rebirth
games.summary: Pheles Rebirth is an RPG where you play as Pheles, a fallen angel who rebelled against God, and lead two knights into battle. Make their choices for them and turn the tide with over 250 skills and abilities in total, plus Unleashed Thoughts, powerful effects triggered by conditions in combat.

games.name: Raiding Season
games.summary: Lead a band of Viking raiders in search of wealth and glory in this turn-based tactical RPG. Recruit warriors, customize their abilities, and battle across deadly hex-based maps. Burn, plunder, and press onward for greater riches but rising enemy resistance could cost you everything you’ve gained.

games.name: Single File
games.summary: A pixel-art auto-battler. An old master and his three students march down the road in single file and fight on their own. The one in front takes the blows, and the fallen walk to the back. You tap the spells, and Spirit doesn't refill by itself. Win or lose, the gold grows the dojo's skill tree.

games.name: Star Purr
games.summary: One cat. Too much catnip. A galaxy of mice between it and its own mind. Star Purr is a psychedelic roguelite shooter: build outrageous weapons, beat bosses born from the psyche, chase the SSS combo.

games.name: Stranding Echoes
games.summary: STRANDING ECHOES is a minimalist colony sim. Manage the non-corporeal creatures called echo to build your base and survive the heat.

games.name: Supinaa: Rogue Sapling
games.summary: You are reborn as sapling and hear voices that that guide your every steps.Fight, explore and power up to survive in this hostile world. You have free will but are the choices always yours?

games.name: Tell Me How I Can Hurt You
games.summary: A psychological visual novel about a girl who’s in love with a teddy bear who’s in love with her. And a secret they both share.

games.name: Terminus: Day Zero
games.summary: Terminus: Day Zero is a free, short zombie survival adventure set in the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors. On the first day of the outbreak, Daisy is home alone, and the dead are getting closer. Hide, shut the doors, and run.

games.name: Tidy Up Christmas Shop
games.summary: 5,434 Christmas items are scattered across the shop. Put them back where they belong and enjoy the wonderful order. No timer, no stress. Upgrade your skills with the candy you earn and arrange colourful, twinkling Christmas items on the shelves of a huge two-storey shop as you like. Merry Christmas!

games.name: Toku's 12 Adventures
games.summary: Experience an exciting Japanese-inspired fantasy RPG adventure featuring action-packed combat, exploration and humour across two unique worlds. GAME FEATURES Action-packed RPG adventure. Explore the Ground World and magical Floating Islands. Battle fantasy creatures and powerful monsters.

games.name: TOO MANY CLANKERS
games.summary: Incremental tower defense game about one simple problem: TOO MANY CLANKERS. Build an absurd amount of firepower and reduce the CLANKERS to scrap.

games.name: Totally Not Gaming
games.summary: In Totally Not Gaming, we offer classic mini-games like Spider Solitaire, FreeCell, Klondike Solitaire, and Minesweeper—all disguised as office software! Come join us for some fun slacking off at work!

games.name: Unbury the Gamer Girl
games.summary: A short, oddball first-person cleanup game about unburying a lonely gamer girl from her own garbage. Throw out trash, upgrade your suction gun, and poke around her room while she talks, complains, and slowly lets her guard down. Crude humor, strange things to find, and someone to hang out with.

games.name: Undervein
games.summary: A pixel-art idle miner. Click the seam, hire ten producers, spend Ancient Ore on gadgets and Cursed Ore on a 50-rune technology tree, then reset for a permanent bonus - fifty times. Minigames behind the ancient door, 1,500 metres of depth.

games.name: Very Very RARE
games.summary: Forge insanely rare turrets in an incremental idle tower defense. Hunt impossible loot, unlock powerful relics, expand your skill tree, complete quests, and discover game-breaking synergies as you chase the rarest drops imaginable.

games.name: Witchkeeping
games.summary: Everything was clean at ten. Now the books are on the floor, potion is running down the wall, and there are muddy footprints on the stairs. Hop on your broom and put the witch's tower back in order, one shelf at a time. And keep an eye on that cat. Nothing sorts itself.

games.name: Wizard of Maths
games.summary: Conquer your maths anxiety and build numerical confidence through fun and challenging quests! Wizard of Maths is a JRPG-inspired, research-backed arithmetic adventure that helps you unlock your inner “human calculator,” whether you’re a child learning the basics or an adult sharpening your skills.

games.name: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic - Space Program
Xiuxian Purge
games.summary: Start as a Qi Refining loose cultivator and forge your path to immortality. Fight with real-time movement, farm monsters on idle auto-hunt, jump in whenever you want.

games.name: YAZAN: Lost Child
games.summary: YAZAN is a 2D psychological anomaly game. Navigate a looping valley, inspect your surroundings for what doesn't belong, and turn back or press forward to make ten correct decisions and escape the loop.

games.name: Anvilia
games.summary: Run a medieval blacksmith shop in co-op. Gather resources, forge tools, stock your shelves, and grow a thriving business.

games.name: Bad Grip Club
games.summary: Bad Grip Club is a physics-based co-op climbing game for VR with crossplay. Climb a cartoonish mountain where physical grip and teamwork are your only hope. Pull your friends up, use quirky items, and survive diverse biomes. Can your squad reach the top without falling down together?

games.name: Card Dice
games.summary: An idle progression game with a casino dice theme. Let your card dice roll automatically and beat opponents in timed matches. Collect gems and engravings to create different builds, trade up your equipment, and advance to higher-level tables.

games.name: Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story - Room & Cozy Activities Expansion
Chinese Landmine Girl: Lan Qiao Afterstory - Winter and Summer of Flowers and Cicadas
Chinese Pancake Simulator
games.summary: Start with a humble pancake stand, purchase ingredients, cook pancakes, serve customers, and upgrade your equipment as you grow your business day by day.

games.name: Chinese-Style Exams
games.summary: How would you score today? Chinese-Style Exams is a nostalgic single-player exam simulator. Work your way from Grade 1 to Grade 12 through Chinese, math, and English exams, review your scores and feedback, and try again as you work toward China's high school and university entrance exams.

games.name: Cities: Skylines - Content Creator Pack: Holiday Getaways
Cities: Skylines - Content Creator Pack: Mansions & Manors
Click Cafe
games.summary: An active incremental where you've inherited a struggling cafe...along with a huge debt. Wait on tables and serve food as orders keep coming in. Purchase upgrades to expand your cafe, make more money, and pay off your debt!

games.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens
Corefall: Idle Dungeon RPG
games.summary: Assemble a party of heroes, descend into a living 3D dungeon, and watch them fight. A deep idle RPG with TONS of ENDLESS Content!

games.name: Critter Rumble
games.summary: Build your team of monsters, choose which enemies to fight, recruit the ones you defeat, and evolve your team in a roguelite autobattler with permanent buffs. Adapt your strategy and face increasingly powerful Bosses!

games.name: Ezalm : Magic's Memory
games.summary: A narrative-driven action RPG where your combat style depends on the elemental magic you choose. Lost in a forgotten region, unravel the mysteries of ancient peoples to find your way back to Ezalm.

games.name: Fantasy Immortal Sect
games.summary: 水墨修仙回合制RPG。你接手一座落魄宗门，于苍梧群山之间招徒纳贤、营建洞天楼阁、开炉炼丹、锻造奇兵、收服培养本命灵兽。前往聚宝当铺与诸派客商互通有无，探索随机生成的大千世界，每局地貌、机缘、敌宗皆不相同。抵御外敌来袭，应对机缘事件，从凡人步步登仙。在东方山水绘卷里慢节奏经营宗门，以策略回合战斗决胜，体验国风水墨的清冷淡雅。这是你亲手写就的修仙长卷。

games.name: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop
games.summary: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop is a cozy organizing simulator where you put back over 4,100 unique fish into their aquariums. Fill the tanks, unlock helpful abilities, and enjoy the satisfying loop of turning total aquatic chaos into a clean, well-organized shop at your own pace.

games.name: For Bumble's Sake
games.summary: You are Brumhilde von Hummelbommel. You wake up alone in February: find a hole in the ground, gather pollen and nectar, raise your daughters and build your nest. Nine months against wasps, birds, storms and heat. In November only one thing counts: is your colony still standing?

games.name: Fruit Store Simulator
games.summary: Stock it, price it, sell it, and turn a small corner fruit shop into the neighborhood's favorite fruit store.

games.name: Hounded Reborn Greyhound Racing
games.summary: Hounded Reborn Greyhound Racing creates a fantasy world of greyhound racing. Buy, name and enjoy your own record breaking champion. Select between pups to buy, trainers, and optionally gamble away your fortune. Achieve cup wins, track records and top the asset value list.

games.name: I'd Choose the Bear
games.summary: Thirty days to save your late Nana's cottage in Honeywood, a lakeside town where bears and people live side by side. Date six very different bears (one of them is technically a human), outwit a resort developer, and decide who you'd really rather meet in the woods.

games.name: Incremental Pachinko Heaven
games.summary: Launch balls! Upgrade the board! Rake in mountains of medals and pay off debt after debt! A focused pachinko incremental game you can finish in 4–6 hours.

games.name: Iron Maw
games.summary: Command the Iron Maw, an armored war train, against the Meridian Iron & Ordnance Company's Legions. Build a devastating convoy, crush colossal war machines, and defend the ten free cities that refuse to kneel.

games.name: Jester's Dungeon
games.summary: An Obscure Dungeon Crawler where you a wizard, Dives into a dungeon to reclaim your stolen Toy from a wicked Jester.  Sacrifice your blood to the Black Eye and  use it's powers to survive, slay monsters and master the dungeon .

games.name: Kingdomsweeper
games.summary: A kingdom-building minesweeper. Defeat monsters, free ruins and restore each part of the kingdom to its former glory in a logic based adventure where each map and puzzle brings new challenges and strategic choices.

games.name: Last Order
games.summary: A narrative adventure set in a quiet bar in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo. Choose a cocktail, listen to stories of life, and leave each night with a poem—all presented through a distinctive visual style inspired by traditional Japanese manga and gekiga.

games.name: Mayhem Duck Simulator
games.summary: Are you ready to explore the freedom of being a rubber duck? ???? Mayhem Duck Simulator is a relaxing yet chaotic plastic duck simulator. Take control of every duck, rescue special friends, and stir up trouble! Whether you seek peace or pure madness, the entire pool is yours to command! ✨????????

games.name: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness
games.summary:
Murmurs of Fear is an episodic psychological horror game, where each episode tells the story of someone who came face to face with something unexplainable.

You are Alex, a 22-year-old electrician sent to a remote island with a lighthouse. A group of geologists had been working there, preparing to reopen the old, sealed mines.

Then, suddenly - all communication stopped.

You arrive alone. Greeted by fog, a storm, the distant lighthouse... and silence. No people. Empty homes. Scattered notes.
And something watching you through the mist.

All you have are your tools, a kerosene lamp, and the growing sense that you're not alone here.

games.name: Ooglie Booglies
games.summary: A 2D shooter where chaos and fun are valued more than perfect skill and strategy. Get more powerful every round and unlock insane new abilities to beat your friends in hilarious and breathtaking ways.

games.name: OutGraft
games.summary: A colossal, grotesque monster never stops chasing you in this fast-paced 2D horror action runner. Slash or leap past enemies, equip different back-mounted parasites each run, and land hits to charge Overheat—then surge forward and trigger their automatic abilities at once before it catches you.

games.name: SHRED A BILLION
games.summary: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 3,929,120,202 bills left to go!

games.name: SquareFrontlineTD
games.summary: This is a classic and visually refreshing 3D floating block map tower defense game. While protecting the base, enjoy the thrill of strategic deployment and repelling groups of enemies, which is perfect for casual players and tower defense enthusiasts.

games.name: Starward Protocol
games.summary: Launch, collect, upgrade! Starward Protocol is an incremental rocket shooter. Build your firepower, expand your upgrade tree, dodge dense bullet patterns, and defeat mechanical bosses on your journey to the stars.

games.name: Starwinder
games.summary: A vertical-scrolling shoot-em-up. Each run takes you through 7 of 14 worlds, every stage ends with a mini boss with its own signature move, and a multi-part final boss waits at the end. Local co-op, Remote Play Together, Daily Challenge and Boss Rush.

games.name: Sun Knight and the Evil Trial
Swift Cultivation
games.summary: Swift Cultivation is a text-based idle cultivation game. Queue up your work and let time do the rest: breakthroughs happen on their own, and every death sends you back stronger.

games.name: The Temple
games.summary: In the far future, explore an abandoned planet aboard three distinct vehicles. Drive deep beneath the sea, glide high amongst the clouds, and fly even higher in orbit. Immerse in the atmosphere, avoid eldritch dangers and figure out what happened in this two hours long cosmic horror adventure.

games.name: ZERO MASS: Custom Colours Supporter Pack
爆増！フラッグ戦記 Demo
Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss
Cursed Words: The Madness Of Michael
My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon
Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators
Nothing Goes Right: Bad Business Demo
Sort of Cheesy: Tidy up the Cheese Cave
SOS :Should I Stay or Should I Hit
Sunstone of Time
games.summary:
Step into the role of a brilliant young scientist whose fascination with ancient relics leads to an unexpected journey through history. Sunstone of Time is a historical VR odyssey where exploration, secret discovery, and intricate puzzle-solving are your keys to survival in the vibrant world of the Aztecs, and your only hope of returning home!

After a groundbreaking experiment goes awry, you awaken in a distant past, thrust into an unfamiliar era. Explore breathtaking temples, ancient settlements, and sacred sites. Piece together forgotten knowledge, interact with a vibrant world, and meet unique characters, each with their own stories and motives. But danger lurks in the shadows: a powerful high priest is weaving dark schemes that threaten not only your fate, but the future of the entire world. Only your intelligence, courage, and insatiable curiosity can guide you through this ancient labyrinth of challenges.

Unravel a rich and engaging story as every step brings you closer to understanding Aztec culture and uncovering the path back to your own time. Will you rise to the challenge, reshape your destiny, and save the world?

games.name: Take This Thing Out Of Me
The Last Embrace: Book One - Official Walkthrough
We Need a Bigger Ship Demo
When Chests Rain Tons of Loot
Age of Failon - Birth of the Hero
Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix
Gravity Switch
games.summary: Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks!

games.name: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price
Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: The False Alice -Retold Tale- Original Soundtrack
The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | Part 1 Soundtrack
Train Sim World® 7: Cargo Line Vol. 8 - Taschenwagen

Persona 4 Revival
games.summary:
In the rural Japanese town of Inaba, the once sleepy streets receive a cold wake-up call when a mysterious serial killer strikes. Also, what's with the rumor of a mysterious TV channel appearing only on rainy nights? 

A whirlwind of surprises and otherworldly adventures will make the next year of your high school life anything but ordinary!

Persona 4 Revival intertwines an investigation into a string of murders with the journey of self-discovery and encounters with the occult, all within a critically acclaimed, classic RPG experience - reborn in a new form!
